verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Demais, veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֥ט הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֖ט אֶת־ עִ֣יר הַדָּמִ֑ים וְה֣וֹדַעְתָּ֔הּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hă·ṯiš·pōṭ hă·ṯiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- ‘îr had·dā·mîm wə·hō·w·ḏa‘·tāh ’êṯ kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: As for you son of man will you judge her Will you pass judgment on the city of bloodshed Then confront her with all her abominations
verses.literalPt: Tu, filho do homem, acaso, julgarás, sim, julgarás a cidade sanguinolenta? Faze-lhe, pois, conhecer todas as suas abominações.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה עִ֣יר שֹׁפֶ֥כֶת דָּ֛ם בְּתוֹכָ֖הּ לָב֣וֹא עִתָּ֑הּ וְעָשְׂתָ֧ה גִלּוּלִ֛ים עָלֶ֖יהָ לְטָמְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ‘îr šō·p̄e·ḵeṯ dām bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh lā·ḇō·w ‘it·tāh wə·‘ā·śə·ṯāh ḡil·lū·lîm ‘ā·le·hā lə·ṭā·mə·’āh
verses.literal: and tell her that this is what the Lord GOD says O city who brings her own doom . . . by shedding blood within her walls and making idols to defile herself
verses.literalPt: Dirás: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Uma cidade que derrama sangue dentro de si para que venha o seu tempo, e que faz ídolos contra si mesmo para se contaminar!

verses.original: בְּדָמֵ֨ךְ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁפַ֜כְתְּ אָשַׁ֗מְתְּ וּבְגִלּוּלַ֤יִךְ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂית֙ טָמֵ֔את וַתַּקְרִ֣יבִי יָמַ֔יִךְ וַתָּב֖וֹא עַד־ שְׁנוֹתָ֑יִךְ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן נְתַתִּ֤יךְ חֶרְפָּה֙ לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְקַלָּסָ֖ה לְכָל־ הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḏā·mêḵ ’ă·šer- šā·p̄aḵt ’ā·šamt ū·ḇə·ḡil·lū·la·yiḵ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śîṯ ṭā·mêṯ wat·taq·rî·ḇî yā·ma·yiḵ wat·tā·ḇō·w ‘aḏ- šə·nō·w·ṯā·yiḵ ‘al- kên nə·ṯat·tîḵ ḥer·pāh lag·gō·w·yim wə·qal·lā·sāh lə·ḵāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: you are guilty of the blood you have shed and you are defiled by the idols you have made You have brought your days to a close and have come to the end of your years Therefore . . . I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the lands
verses.literalPt: Pelo teu sangue que derramaste, te fazes culpada; e, pelos teus ídolos que fabricaste, estás contaminada; e fizeste avizinhar os teus dias e és chegada até os teus anos. Por isso, eu te fiz o opróbrio das nações e o escárnio de todos os países.

verses.original: הַקְּרֹב֛וֹת וְהָרְחֹק֥וֹת מִמֵּ֖ךְ יִתְקַלְּסוּ־ בָ֑ךְ טְמֵאַ֣ת הַשֵּׁ֔ם רַבַּ֖ת הַמְּהוּמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: haq·qə·rō·ḇō·wṯ wə·hā·rə·ḥō·qō·wṯ mim·mêḵ yiṯ·qal·lə·sū- ḇāḵ ṭə·mê·’aṯ haš·šêm rab·baṯ ham·mə·hū·māh
verses.literal: Those near and far will mock you O infamous city . . . full of turmoil
verses.literalPt: Os que estão perto e os que estão longe de ti escarnecerão de ti, ó infame e cheia de tumultos.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֥ישׁ לִזְרֹע֖וֹ הָ֣יוּ בָ֑ךְ לְמַ֖עַן שְׁפָךְ־ דָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh nə·śî·’ê yiś·rā·’êl ’îš liz·rō·‘ōw hā·yū ḇāḵ lə·ma·‘an šə·p̄āḵ- dām
verses.literal: See how every prince of Israel within you has used his power to shed blood
verses.literalPt: Eis que os príncipes de Israel, cada um conforme o seu poder, têm estado no meio de ti, para derramarem o sangue.

verses.original: אָ֤ב וָאֵם֙ הֵקַ֣לּוּ בָ֔ךְ לַגֵּ֛ר עָשׂ֥וּ בַעֹ֖שֶׁק בְּתוֹכֵ֑ךְ יָת֥וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֖ה ה֥וֹנוּ בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āḇ wā·’êm hê·qal·lū ḇāḵ lag·gêr ‘ā·śū ḇa·‘ō·šeq bə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ yā·ṯō·wm wə·’al·mā·nāh hō·w·nū ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Father and mother are treated with contempt Within your walls the foreign resident is exploited . . . the fatherless and the widow are oppressed
verses.literalPt: No meio de ti, fizeram pouco caso de seu pai e de sua mãe; no meio de ti, usaram de opressão para com o estrangeiro; no meio de ti, foram injustos para com o órfão e a viúva.

verses.original: קָדָשַׁ֖י בָּזִ֑ית וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י חִלָּֽלְתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: qā·ḏā·šay bā·zîṯ wə·’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·ṯay ḥil·lā·lət
verses.literal: You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths
verses.literalPt: Desprezaste as minhas coisas sagradas e profanaste os meus sábados.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י רָכִ֛יל הָ֥יוּ בָ֖ךְ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ־ דָּ֑ם וְאֶל־ הֶֽהָרִים֙ אָ֣כְלוּ בָ֔ךְ זִמָּ֖ה עָשׂ֥וּ בְתוֹכֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê rā·ḵîl hā·yū ḇāḵ lə·ma·‘an šə·p̄āḵ- dām wə·’el- he·hā·rîm ’ā·ḵə·lū ḇāḵ zim·māh ‘ā·śū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ
verses.literal: Among you are slanderous men bent on bloodshed within you are those who eat on the mountain shrines and commit acts of indecency
verses.literalPt: Homens caluniadores acharam-se no meio de ti para derramarem o sangue; e no meio de ti comeram sobre os montes; no meio de ti praticaram a luxúria.

verses.original: עֶרְוַת־ אָ֖ב גִּלָּה־ בָ֑ךְ טְמֵאַ֥ת הַנִּדָּ֖ה עִנּוּ־ בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ- ’āḇ gil·lāh- ḇāḵ ṭə·mê·’aṯ han·nid·dāh ‘in·nū- ḇāḵ
verses.literal: In you they have uncovered the nakedness of their fathers in you they violate women during their menstrual impurity . . .
verses.literalPt: No meio de ti descobriram a nudez de seus pais; no meio de ti humilharam a que estava imunda no tempo da sua separação.

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ׀ אֶת־ אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֗הוּ עָשָׂה֙ תּֽוֹעֵבָ֔ה וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ כַּלָּת֖וֹ טִמֵּ֣א בְזִמָּ֑ה וְאִ֛ישׁ אֶת־ אֲחֹת֥וֹ בַת־ אָבִ֖יו עִנָּה־ בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ rê·‘ê·hū ‘ā·śāh tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh wə·’îš ’eṯ- kal·lā·ṯōw ṭim·mê ḇə·zim·māh wə·’îš ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw ḇaṯ- ’ā·ḇîw ‘in·nāh- ḇāḵ
verses.literal: One man commits an abomination with his neighbor’s wife another wickedly defiles his daughter-in-law and yet another violates his sister his own father’s daughter
verses.literalPt: Um praticou o que é abominável com a mulher do seu próximo, outro contaminou com luxúria sua nora, e outro no meio de ti humilhou sua irmã, filha de seu pai.

verses.original: שֹׁ֥חַד לָֽקְחוּ־ בָ֖ךְ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ־ דָּ֑ם נֶ֧שֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּ֣ית לָקַ֗חַתְּ וַתְּבַצְּעִ֤י רֵעַ֙יִךְ֙ בַּעֹ֔שֶׁק וְאֹתִ֣י שָׁכַ֔חַתְּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šō·ḥaḏ lā·qə·ḥū- ḇāḵ lə·ma·‘an šə·p̄āḵ- dām ne·šeḵ wə·ṯar·bîṯ lā·qa·ḥat wat·tə·ḇaṣ·ṣə·‘î rê·‘a·yiḵ ba·‘ō·šeq wə·’ō·ṯî šā·ḵa·ḥat nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: In you they take bribes to shed blood You engage in usury take excess interest and extort your neighbors But Me you have forgotten declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: No meio de ti, receberam peitas para derramarem o sangue; usura e ganhos ilícitos tomaste; e ávido de sórdidas ganâncias, trataste o teu próximo com opressão e de mim te esqueceste, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ הִכֵּ֣יתִי כַפִּ֔י אֶל־ בִּצְעֵ֖ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית וְעַ֨ל־ דָּמֵ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ בְּתוֹכֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh hik·kê·ṯî ḵap·pî ’el- biṣ·‘êḵ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śîṯ wə·‘al- dā·mêḵ ’ă·šer hā·yū bə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ
verses.literal: Now look I strike My hands together against your unjust gain - and against the blood you have shed - in your midst
verses.literalPt: Eis que, portanto, bati as mãos contra o lucro desonesto que ganhaste e contra o teu sangue que houve no meio de ti.

verses.original: הֲיַעֲמֹ֤ד לִבֵּךְ֙ אִם־ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יָדַ֔יִךְ לַיָּמִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ךְ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִֽׂיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ya·‘ă·mōḏ lib·bêḵ ’im- te·ḥĕ·zaq·nāh yā·ḏa·yiḵ lay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh ’ō·w·ṯāḵ ’ă·nî Yah·weh dib·bar·tî wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî
verses.literal: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you I the LORD have spoken and I will act
verses.literalPt: Poderá o teu coração estar firme ou poderão ser fortes as tuas mãos nos dias em que eu tratarei contigo? Eu, Jeová, o disse e o farei.

verses.original: וַהֲפִיצוֹתִ֤י אוֹתָךְ֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְזֵרִיתִ֖יךְ בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וַהֲתִמֹּתִ֥י טֻמְאָתֵ֖ךְ מִמֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·p̄î·ṣō·w·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bag·gō·w·yim wə·zê·rî·ṯîḵ bā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ wa·hă·ṯim·mō·ṯî ṭum·’ā·ṯêḵ mim·mêḵ
verses.literal: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you throughout the lands I will purge your uncleanness . . .
verses.literalPt: Espalhar-te-ei entre as nações, e te dispersarei pelos países, e de ti consumirei a tua imundícia.

verses.original: וְנִחַ֥לְתְּ בָּ֖ךְ לְעֵינֵ֣י גוֹיִ֑ם וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ni·ḥalt bāḵ lə·‘ê·nê ḡō·w·yim wə·yā·ḏa·‘at kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: And when you have defiled yourself in the eyes of the nations then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Serás profanada em ti mesma, à vista das nações, e saberás que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הָיוּ־ לִ֥י בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְסוּג כֻּלָּ֡ם נְ֠חֹשֶׁת וּבְדִ֨יל וּבַרְזֶ֤ל וְעוֹפֶ֙רֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר סִגִ֥ים כֶּ֖סֶף הָיֽוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām hā·yū- lî ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lə·sūḡ kul·lām nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·ḇə·ḏîl ū·ḇar·zel wə·‘ō·w·p̄e·reṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ kūr si·ḡîm ke·sep̄ hā·yū
verses.literal: Son of man the house of Israel has become dross to Me All of them are copper tin iron and lead inside the furnace they are but the dross of silver
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, a casa de Israel tem-se tornado para mim em escória; todos eles são cobre, e estanho, e ferro, e chumbo, no meio da fornalha; eles são a escória da prata.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֛עַן הֱי֥וֹת כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם לְסִגִ֑ים לָכֵן֙ הִנְנִ֣י קֹבֵ֣ץ אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ תּ֖וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an hĕ·yō·wṯ kul·lə·ḵem lə·si·ḡîm lā·ḵên hin·nî qō·ḇêṣ ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- tō·wḵ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Because all of you have become dross behold I will gather you into . . . Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porquanto todos vós vos tornastes em escória, portanto eis que eu vos ajuntarei no meio de Jerusalém.

verses.original: קְבֻ֣צַת כֶּ֡סֶף וּ֠נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶ֨ל וְעוֹפֶ֤רֶת וּבְדִיל֙ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר לָפַֽחַת־ עָלָ֥יו אֵ֖שׁ לְהַנְתִּ֑יךְ כֵּ֤ן אֶקְבֹּץ֙ בְּאַפִּ֣י וּבַחֲמָתִ֔י וְהִנַּחְתִּ֥י וְהִתַּכְתִּ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ḇu·ṣaṯ ke·sep̄ ū·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·ḇar·zel wə·‘ō·w·p̄e·reṯ ū·ḇə·ḏîl ’el- tō·wḵ kūr lā·p̄a·ḥaṯ- ‘ā·lāw ’êš lə·han·tîḵ kên ’eq·bōṣ bə·’ap·pî ū·ḇa·ḥă·mā·ṯî wə·hin·naḥ·tî wə·hit·taḵ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: Just as one gathers silver copper iron lead and tin into . . . the furnace to melt with a fiery blast . . . so I will gather you in My anger and wrath leave you there and melt you
verses.literalPt: Como se ajuntam a prata, e o cobre, e o ferro, e o chumbo, e o estanho no meio da fornalha, para assoprar o fogo sobre eles, com o fim de os fundir, assim vos ajuntarei na minha ira e no meu furor, e ali vos porei, e vos fundirei.

verses.original: וְכִנַּסְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְנָפַחְתִּ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּאֵ֣שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֑י וְנִתַּכְתֶּ֖ם בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵin·nas·tî ’eṯ·ḵem wə·nā·p̄aḥ·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem bə·’êš ‘eḇ·rā·ṯî wə·nit·taḵ·tem bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: Yes, I will gather you together and blow on you with the fire of My wrath and you will be melted within the city
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, congregar-vos-ei e assoprarei sobre vós com o fogo da minha ira, e sereis fundidos no meio dela.

verses.original: כְּהִתּ֥וּךְ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר כֵּ֖ן תֻּתְּכ֣וּ בְתוֹכָ֑הּ וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שָׁפַ֥כְתִּי חֲמָתִ֖י עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: kə·hit·tūḵ ke·sep̄ bə·ṯō·wḵ kūr kên tut·tə·ḵū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh šā·p̄aḵ·tî ḥă·mā·ṯî ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: As silver is melted in a furnace so you will be melted within the city Then you will know that I the LORD have poured out My wrath upon you
verses.literalPt: Como se funde a prata no meio da fornalha, assim sereis fundidos no meio dela; e sabereis que eu, Jeová, derramei o meu furor sobre vós.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם אֱמָר־ לָ֕הּ אַ֣תְּ אֶ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א מְטֹהָרָ֖ה הִ֑יא לֹ֥א גֻשְׁמָ֖הּ בְּי֥וֹם זָֽעַם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām ’ĕ·mār- lāh ’at ’e·reṣ lō mə·ṭō·hā·rāh hî lō ḡuš·māh bə·yō·wm zā·‘am
verses.literal: Son of man say to her In the day of indignation you are a land that has not been cleansed upon which . . . no rain has fallen
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, dize-lhe a ela: Tu és uma terra que não está purificada, nem regada de chuvas no dia da indignação.

verses.original: קֶ֤שֶׁר נְבִיאֶ֙יהָ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ כַּאֲרִ֥י שׁוֹאֵ֖ג טֹ֣רֵֽף טָ֑רֶף נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָכָ֗לוּ חֹ֤סֶן וִיקָר֙ יִקָּ֔חוּ אַלְמְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ הִרְבּ֥וּ בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: qe·šer nə·ḇî·’e·hā bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh ka·’ă·rî šō·w·’êḡ ṭō·rêp̄ ṭā·rep̄ ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḵā·lū ḥō·sen wî·qār yiq·qā·ḥū ’al·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā hir·bū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: The conspiracy of the princes in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing its prey They devour the people seize the treasures and precious things and multiply the widows within her
verses.literalPt: Há, no meio dela, uma conspiração dos seus profetas, como um leão que ruge e que arrebata a presa. Eles devoram almas, recebem tesouros e coisas preciosas; multiplicam as suas viúvas no meio dela.

verses.original: כֹּהֲנֶ֜יהָ חָמְס֣וּ תוֹרָתִי֮ וַיְחַלְּל֣וּ קָדָשַׁי֒ בֵּֽין־ קֹ֤דֶשׁ לְחֹל֙ לֹ֣א הִבְדִּ֔ילוּ וּבֵין־ הַטָּמֵ֥א לְטָה֖וֹר לֹ֣א הוֹדִ֑יעוּ וּמִשַׁבְּתוֹתַי֙ הֶעְלִ֣ימוּ עֵֽינֵיהֶ֔ם וָאֵחַ֖ל בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kō·hă·ne·hā ḥā·mə·sū ṯō·w·rā·ṯî way·ḥal·lə·lū qā·ḏā·šay bên- qō·ḏeš lə·ḥōl lō hiḇ·dî·lū ū·ḇên- haṭ·ṭā·mê lə·ṭā·hō·wr lō hō·w·ḏî·‘ū ū·mi·šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay he‘·lî·mū ‘ê·nê·hem wā·’ê·ḥal bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: Her priests do violence to My law and profane My holy things They make no distinction between the holy and the common and they fail to distinguish between the clean and the unclean They disregard . . . My Sabbaths so that I am profaned among them
verses.literalPt: Os seus sacerdotes violentam a minha lei e profanam as minhas coisas sagradas. Não distinguem entre o santo e o profano, nem fazem que os homens discirnam a diferença entre o imundo e o limpo e dos meus sábados escondem os seus olhos; e eu sou profanado entre eles.

verses.original: שָׂרֶ֣יהָ בְקִרְבָּ֔הּ כִּזְאֵבִ֖ים טֹ֣רְפֵי טָ֑רֶף לִשְׁפָּךְ־ דָּם֙ לְאַבֵּ֣ד נְפָשׁ֔וֹת לְמַ֖עַן בְּצֹ֥עַ בָּֽצַע׃
verses.transliteration: śā·re·hā ḇə·qir·bāh kiz·’ê·ḇîm ṭō·rə·p̄ê ṭā·rep̄ liš·pāḵ- dām lə·’ab·bêḏ nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ lə·ma·‘an bə·ṣō·a‘ bā·ṣa‘
verses.literal: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey shedding blood and destroying lives for dishonest gain . . .
verses.literalPt: Os seus príncipes no meio dela são como lobos que arrebatam a presa para derramarem o sangue e destruírem as almas, a fim de ganharem lucro desonesto.

verses.original: וּנְבִיאֶ֗יהָ טָח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ תָּפֵ֔ל חֹזִ֣ים שָׁ֔וְא וְקֹסְמִ֥ים לָהֶ֖ם כָּזָ֑ב אֹמְרִ֗ים כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וַֽיהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א דִבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ḇî·’e·hā ṭā·ḥū lā·hem tā·p̄êl ḥō·zîm šāw wə·qō·sə·mîm lā·hem kā·zāḇ ’ō·mə·rîm kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh Yah·weh lō ḏib·bêr
verses.literal: Her prophets whitewash these deeds by false visions and lying divinations saying This is what the Lord GOD says when the LORD has not spoken
verses.literalPt: Vendo vaidades e adivinhando-lhes mentiras, os seus profetas rebocam para eles com argamassa magra, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová, quando Jeová não falou.

verses.original: עַ֤ם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ עָ֣שְׁקוּ עֹ֔שֶׁק וְגָזְל֖וּ גָּזֵ֑ל וְעָנִ֤י וְאֶבְיוֹן֙ הוֹנ֔וּ וְאֶת־ הַגֵּ֥ר עָשְׁק֖וּ בְּלֹ֥א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ ‘ā·šə·qū ‘ō·šeq wə·ḡā·zə·lū gā·zêl wə·‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn hō·w·nū wə·’eṯ- hag·gêr ‘ā·šə·qū bə·lō miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery . . . They have oppressed the poor and needy and have exploited the foreign resident without justice
verses.literalPt: O povo da terra usou de opressão e praticou roubos; afligiu ao pobre e ao necessitado; oprimiu injustamente ao estrangeiro.

verses.original: וָאֲבַקֵּ֣שׁ מֵהֶ֡ם אִ֣ישׁ גֹּֽדֵר־ גָּדֵר֩ וְעֹמֵ֨ד בַּפֶּ֧רֶץ לְפָנַ֛י בְּעַ֥ד הָאָ֖רֶץ לְבִלְתִּ֣י שַׁחֲתָ֑הּ וְלֹ֖א מָצָֽאתִי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ḇaq·qêš mê·hem ’îš gō·ḏêr- gā·ḏêr wə·‘ō·mêḏ bap·pe·reṣ lə·p̄ā·nay bə·‘aḏ hā·’ā·reṣ lə·ḇil·tî ša·ḥă·ṯāh wə·lō mā·ṣā·ṯî
verses.literal: I searched for a man among them to repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land so that I should not destroy it But I found no one
verses.literalPt: Busquei entre eles um homem que consertasse a sebe e que se pusesse na brecha diante de mim por esta terra, para que eu não a destruísse; porém não o achei.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ זַעְמִ֔י בְּאֵ֥שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֖י כִּלִּיתִ֑ים דַּרְכָּם֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֣ם נָתַ֔תִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·pōḵ ‘ă·lê·hem za‘·mî bə·’êš ‘eḇ·rā·ṯî kil·lî·ṯîm dar·kām bə·rō·šām nā·ṯat·tî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: So I have poured out My indignation upon them and consumed them with the fire of My fury I have brought their ways down upon their own heads declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Por isso, derramei sobre eles a minha indignação; com o fogo do meu furor os consumi; fiz que o seu caminho lhes recaísse sobre a cabeça, diz o Senhor Jeová.
